mentions.name: Local Claude Co-work
mentions.description: A local, LLM-powered document organization tool that helps find everything on the hard drive and turns it into a knowledge graph/mind map without sending data to the cloud, with duplicate removal and disk cleanup as a bonus.
mentions.problem: Organizing and searching files on a local hard drive into a knowledge base without sending everything to the cloud, plus dealing with duplicates and disk clutter.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project: a local version of Claude Co-work for document organization, one of my original projects that I wanted from back in 2024, so it could help me find everything on my hard drive and turn it into a knowledge graph/mind map without sending everything over the cloud. Bonus for removing duplicates/disk cleanup.
